target: Note Printing Australia-style customer list on other printers' sites (De La Rue, G+D, Crane Currency, Oberthur Fiduciaire, IDEMIA, Veridos, Bundesdruckerei, Goznak, KOMSCO, Orell Fussli, CBPM, Canadian Bank Note, BA International, Royal Joh. Enschede, FNMT, Casa da Moeda do Brasil, Thomas Greg & Sons, Landqart, SPMCIL, Pakistan Security Printing)
what_was_tried: Eight WebSearches aimed at 'our customers' / 'references' / 'clients' / 'who we work with' pages for these firms, plus searches for press releases naming a specific central bank.
result: NO commercial printer other than PWPW was found to publish a named customer list. Oberthur Fiduciaire's marketing claims 'over 70 central banks among references' but no page names them. G+D's pages (gi-de.com banknote-printing, currency-technology) name no customers. Orell Fussli's orellfuessli.com/en/security names none. Canadian Bank Note's cbnco.com/?p=141 carries only one named client testimonial, from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (NZL already recorded). Do not re-hunt generic customer-list pages for these firms; go straight to their news/press-release archives instead, which is where PWPW's named customers were found.

target: PWPW (Polish Security Printing Works) news archive - the one printer that does name customers
what_was_tried: Fetched pwpw.pl/en/News pages: 'More banknotes from Poland for Paraguay' (2014), 'The value of PWPW exports doubled in 2018' (Jan 2019), '35 tons of cash from Poland' (2015).
result: PRODUCTIVE - yielded PRY and DOM records. The 2019 exports page also names Banco de Guatemala (GTM, already recorded), 170 million banknotes for Honduras (HND, already recorded) and 'a collector banknote for Djibouti in Africa'. The Djibouti item was NOT filed: a collector banknote is not the country's circulating currency and the page says nothing about who prints Djibouti's circulating notes. The page warns 'Most of PWPW contracts are secret'. Remaining unfetched PWPW news pages ('PWPW to manufacture notes for Guatemala' 2018, 'First Polish polymer banknote' 2014, '97 years of PWPW's history' 2016) are worth a later pass.

target: Perum Peruri (Indonesia) export customers
what_was_tried: Searched for Peruri's foreign banknote customers; fetched two Detik Finance reports (8 Jan 2020 and 13 Dec 2022).
result: PRODUCTIVE for PER only. Peruri's named banknote customers are Peru, Nepal and Sri Lanka (NPL and LKA already recorded). Argentina was only a prospect being courted as of Dec 2022, not an order - do not file ARG from these pages. No Peruri-hosted customer list was found; the records come from Indonesian business press.

target: China Banknote Printing and Minting (CBPM) customer countries

result: Names nine customers - Brazil, India, Nepal, Poland, Thailand, Bangladesh, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Pakistan - and Nepal Rastra Bank specifically. ALL NINE are already recorded, so this page yields zero new records. Do not re-fetch it.

target: BCEAO (West African CFA, file under SEN) printer

result: The page says only that 'la BCEAO procede a des commandes de billets et pieces de monnaie neufs' and that the Direction des Activites Fiduciaires places the orders. It names NO printing works, no Banque de France, no firm. BCEAO printer still unknown.

target: BEAC (Central African CFA, file under CMR) printer, and Banque de France as a supplier to other central banks
what_was_tried: Searched for BEAC/Chamalieres; fetched banque-france.fr 'Concevoir, fabriquer papier fiduciaire, billets' (its services page for central banks and public institutions).
result: The Banque de France page names NO customer. It says only 'Elle fournit a differentes banques centrales nationales disposant de leur propre imprimerie' and 'elle imprime des devises qui circulent dans plus de vingt pays a travers le monde' - over twenty countries, none named. Dead end for both BEAC and for harvesting Banque de France customers.

target: Currency News 'Data Vault' issuing-authority directory (datavault.reconnaissance.net/authorities)
what_was_tried: Fetched page 2 of 5 of the authority list.
result: It is a bare directory of ~50 issuing authorities per page with NO printer named anywhere. Not a source for printer records. Do not fetch the other pages for this purpose.

target: banknotes.com/printers.htm (appeared in four searches as an apparent printer directory)
what_was_tried: Fetched the page.
result: It lists printers with the country the PRINTER is in (e.g. 'Peruri - Perum Percetakan Uang RI (Indonesia)'), not the countries they print for. Useless for this task. Do not fetch again.

target: Central Bank of Belize - 2025 banknote series printer

result: De La Rue is named ONLY as the publisher of the 'Going Beyond' newsletter in which the Bank's interview appeared - the page does not say De La Rue printed or produced the notes. Not filed. The underlying De La Rue 'Going Beyond' newsletter is the lead to chase for BLZ.

target: Bank of Namibia - printer of the 2025 upgraded banknote series

A linked PDF media release on the same site was not included in the page text and was not fetched - that PDF, plus bon.com.na 'Official Issuance of Upgraded Banknotes and New Co' and the Bank of Namibia document at currencyaffairs.org, are the remaining leads for NAM.

result: The Bank's own banknote pages list size, colour, date of issuance, obverse and reverse and security features but NAME NO PRINTER. The ALB record came instead from the De La Rue press release. Do not re-check the Bank of Albania's own banknote pages.

Other candidate cb.is URLs seen in search results and not yet tried: /publications/news/news/2013/10/24/New-10-000-kr.-banknote-in-circulation/ and the 2003/2004/2005 upgraded-banknote articles. ISL still open.

target: Banque d'Algerie - Direction generale de l'Hotel des Monnaies as the state printing works
what_was_tried: Fetched bank-of-algeria.dz/direction-generale-de-lhotel-des-monnaies/.
result: BLOCKED: the site returns robots_disallowed, nothing retrieved. bank-of-algeria.dz cannot be fetched by this tool at all, so no official Algerian source is reachable this way. Alternative leads for DZA: tsa-algerie.com article on the history of Algerian banknotes, and a currency-news.com piece 'Celebration of independence and technology' (Dec 2022).

target: Banque Centrale de Tunisie, and Arab states generally, printing their own money
what_was_tried: Searched in French; fetched tunisienumerique.com 'Quels sont les pays arabes qui impriment leur propre monnaie'.
result: The article states that Morocco, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Algeria 'maitriser toute la chaine monetaire' and that Sudan and Jordan also print domestically, while Tunisia mints coins locally but has its banknotes printed abroad; Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Lebanon, Libya, Syria, Mauritania, Djibouti, Comoros and Palestine 'externalisent largement l'impression de leur propre monnaie'. It names NO printing works and NO firm for any of them, only 'des entreprises europeennes specialisees'. Because the schema needs a named entity, nothing could be filed - but this page is a useful signpost that SAU, JOR and DZA have their own works and that TUN, QAT, BHR, OMN, LBN, SYR, MRT, DJI, COM, PSE print abroad.

target: Monetary Authority of Macao (AMCM) printer

result: The page covers only a banknote exchange deadline and names no printer. MAC still open; the Coin World piece on Macau's 2024 series and AMCM's own site are untried.

target: Bank of Russia / Goznak, and Czech National Bank circulating-note printer

result: No cbr.ru page naming Goznak surfaced in search at all - every hit was Wikipedia or press. RUS still open. A CNB photo gallery titled 'Vyroba bankovky 1 000 Kc s pritiskem ve Statni tiskarne cenin' is an untried lead for a firmer CZE record.
